name: core-alchemy
description: The Alchemy program that deploys one mind as a stack of Workers

scripts.deploy: f() { node --env-file-if-exists=.secrets scripts/refuse-older-stack.ts "$@" && pnpm --filter core-mind-worker build && node --env-file-if-exists=.secrets scripts/repos-namespace.ts "$@" && node --env-file-if-exists=.secrets node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js deploy "$@"; }; f
scripts.plan: pnpm --filter core-mind-worker build && node --env-file-if-exists=.secrets node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js plan
